formats: one-liner — a single sentence. the entire take, nothing added. if it needs two sentences, it is probably too long. cut to the bone.

quick hot take — 2-4 short lines, reads like a thought you just had. don't over-explain it. end when you have made your point.

reaction to news — sounds like you just read something and opened X to respond. casual, immediate, a little annoyed or surprised.
